description: Works to tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 1: (1) English Oak - remove epicormic growth to the height of the first major limb over the road, crown lift to 4.5m above carriageway, (4) Common Holly - stump with regrowth to 1.2m height. Remove Laburnum within and treat stump to prevent regrowth, (5,6) 2x Sycamore, (7) English Oak - crown lift to 3m above pavement and 4.5m above roadway, reduce branches by 1.5m on East and West crown, (17) Horse Chestnut - remove epicormic growth up to the first major branch, repeat crown reduction pruning to the previous pruning points.
